disclaimer: Only milestones confirmed word for word in the sources; series breaks and methodological divergences are noted on each indicator and in the methodology. Primary IBGE sources verified through official releases reproduced by Agência Brasil/EBC and the press.
indicators[0].note: Population aged 15 and over, census series. The PNAD Contínua household survey records less: 4.9% in 2025. And literate on paper is not the same as a real reader: INAF estimates 29% functional illiteracy among the literate.
indicators[1].note: During the pandemic it fell to 72.8 years (2021) and only regained the previous level in 2023. The original annual life tables give slightly lower figures for 2000 and 2010; we use the IBGE's revised decennial series.
indicators[2].note: Deaths before the first birthday per 1,000 live births. The lowest figure on record was 11.5 (2020); since then the fall has stalled at ~12.5. For 2010, estimates range from ~16 (census) to 17.2 (life tables).
indicators[3].note: Connection to the main sewage network. After 80 years of rising tax revenue, almost 4 in every 10 Brazilians still have no sewage connection. Series break: 1970-1980 measure households (academic study); 2000-2022, population (IBGE).
indicators[4].note: Homicides per 100,000 people (SIM/Datasus, series since 1979). The rate almost tripled between 1980 and the 2017 peak and has fallen 30% since. In 2024 there were 42,590 homicides, the lowest absolute number on record — with a warning from the Atlas itself about growing under-reporting. Intermediate milestones from the Mapa da Violência were left out because we could not confirm them at the source.
indicators[5].note: Unemployment rate, annual average. A comparable national series only exists from 2012 (PNAD Contínua, reweighted after the 2022 census). Earlier measurements — PME (6 metropolitan areas) and PED (Dieese, a broader concept) — are not comparable with each other or with the current one, so they are left off the chart.
sourcesNote: IBGE portals were unreachable to the research robot; figures were checked against official releases reproduced by Agência Brasil/EBC and the press, with the primary URLs kept for verification.
